subject.title: [Bug]: Bootstrap files in agentDir are silently ignored — only workspace directory files are injected into system prompt

question: Should configured per-agent agentDir files become bootstrap prompt authority, or should OpenClaw keep workspace-only bootstrap loading and warn when agentDir contains ignored bootstrap filenames?
rationale: The source bug is clear, but the open PRs choose different trust boundaries for security-critical AGENTS/SOUL prompt files, and cleanup automation should not choose that product/security policy.

options.title: Keep workspace-only and warn
options.body: Land a warning/docs path so misplaced agentDir bootstrap files become visible while workspace remains the canonical prompt source.

options.title: Allow explicit agentDir bootstrap authority
options.body: Land an agentDir-loading path only with explicit precedence, diagnostics, docs, upgrade compatibility, and security proof.

options.title: Split mitigation from feature work
options.body: Ship warning-only diagnostics now and track per-agent agentDir bootstrap loading as a separate product/security design item.

recommendation.title: Keep workspace-only and warn
recommendation.body: Land a warning/docs path so misplaced agentDir bootstrap files become visible while workspace remains the canonical prompt source.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest traced history on the bootstrap resolver and workspace bootstrap behavior.
